lines.rookie:
TOYMAKER HIDES A SINGING BIRD
Miss Eleanor Hart has made a silver bird that sings.
She calls it the Silver Lark.
She has hidden it in New York for a child of the city.
"My notebook's last page is the first clue," she says.
"Each clue is kept by a friend of the city.
Each friend will ask one question.
Only a careful reader can answer it."
lines.junior:
TOYMAKER HIDES A SINGING BIRD
Miss Eleanor Hart has built a silver bird that can sing.
She calls it the Silver Lark.
She has hidden it somewhere in New York for a child of the city.
"The last page of my notebook is the first clue," she says.
"Each clue is kept by a friend of the city.
Each friend will ask one question.
Only a careful reader will know the answer."
lines.master:
TOYMAKER HIDES A SINGING BIRD
Miss Eleanor Hart has crafted a silver bird that truly sings.
She has named it the Silver Lark.
She has concealed it in New York for a child of the city.
"The final page of my notebook is the first clue," she explains.
"Each clue is kept by a friend of the city.
Each friend will ask one question.
Only a careful reader will be able to answer it."

lines.rookie: a busy train hall under a plain glass roof, with no stars
lines.junior: a busy train hall under a plain glass roof, without any stars
lines.master: a bustling train hall beneath a plain glass roof, entirely starless

lines.rookie: THE GREAT HALL OF TRAINS
lines.junior: THE GREAT HALL OF TRAINS
lines.master: THE GREAT HALL OF TRAINS

lines.rookie: Eleanor's first friend waits at Grand Central's Lost and Found.
lines.junior: Eleanor's first friend is waiting at the Lost and Found in Grand Central.
lines.master: Eleanor's first friend awaits you at Grand Central's Lost and Found.

lines.rookie: A small light moves in the hall
lines.junior: A small light moves through the hall
lines.master: A small light drifts through the hall

lines.rookie: The library opens
lines.junior: The library opens its doors
lines.master: The library opens for the day

lines.rookie: Frank sees the page on his round
lines.junior: Frank sees the page during his round
lines.master: Frank checks the page on his round

lines.rookie: A man with a black bag leaves
lines.junior: A man with a black bag goes out
lines.master: A man with a black bag slips away

lines.rookie: Dr. Brooks locks the case
lines.junior: Dr. Brooks locks the glass case
lines.master: Dr. Brooks secures the case

lines.rookie: three hours after Dr. Brooks locked the case
lines.junior: three hours after Dr. Brooks locked the case
lines.master: three hours after Dr. Brooks locked the case

lines.rookie: five minutes after the light
lines.junior: five minutes after the light
lines.master: five minutes after the light

lines.rookie: The Night in Order
lines.junior: The Night in Order
lines.master: The Night in Order

lines.rookie: THE LIBRARY STEPS
lines.junior: THE LIBRARY STEPS
lines.master: THE LIBRARY STEPS

lines.rookie: You sit on the steps between the two stone lions.
lines.junior: You sit down on the steps between the two stone lions.
lines.master: You settle on the steps between the two stone lions.

lines.rookie: A thin strip of the page is still in the notebook. Its edge is a zigzag with three points.
lines.junior: A thin strip of the page is still left in the notebook. Its edge is a zigzag with three points.
lines.master: A slender strip of the page remains in the notebook. Its edge forms a zigzag with three points.

lines.rookie: "Let's put last night in order," Maya says.
lines.junior: "Let's put the events of last night in order," Maya says.
lines.master: "Let's piece last night together in order," Maya suggests.

lines.rookie: Maya's notes say:
lines.junior: Maya's notes read:
lines.master: Maya's notes record:

lines.rookie:
Frank saw the page on his round three hours after Dr. Brooks locked the case.
The small light moved in the hall one hour after Frank's round.
Sam saw the man with the black bag five minutes after the light.
The library opens at ten the next morning.
lines.junior:
Frank saw the page on his round three hours after Dr. Brooks locked the case.
The small light moved through the hall one hour after Frank's round.
Sam saw the man with the black bag five minutes after the light.
The library opens at ten the following morning.
lines.master:
Frank checked the page on his round three hours after Dr. Brooks locked the case.
One hour after Frank's round, the small light drifted through the hall.
Sam spotted the man with the black bag five minutes after the light.
The library opens its doors at ten the following morning.

lines.rookie: Put last night in order, from first to last. When was the page taken?
lines.junior: Put the events of last night in order, from first to last. When was the page taken?
lines.master: Arrange last night's events from first to last. When was the page taken?

lines.rookie: Find the first thing: everything else comes after it.
lines.junior: Find the first event: everything else happens after it.
lines.master: Identify the earliest event: everything else follows it.

lines.rookie: The library opening is the next morning. Is it part of the night?
lines.junior: The library opens the next morning. Is that part of the night?
lines.master: The library opens the following morning. Does that belong to the night at all?

lines.rookie: Now you know when the page was taken!
lines.junior: Now you know when the page was taken!
lines.master: Now you know exactly when the page was taken!

lines.rookie: Between nine and ten past ten, the page was taken.
lines.junior: The page was taken between nine and ten past ten.
lines.master: Sometime between nine and ten past ten, the page was stolen.

lines.rookie: Then the thief left by the side door with a black bag.
lines.junior: Then the thief went out by the side door with a black bag.
lines.master: Then the thief slipped out by the side door, carrying a black bag.

lines.rookie: Suddenly, a TV van stops by the lions.
lines.junior: All of a sudden, a TV van stops next to the lions.
lines.master: Abruptly, a TV van pulls up beside the lions.

lines.rookie: Find what came first. Then read 'after' in each line.
lines.junior: Find the first event. Then read 'after' in every line.
lines.master: Pinpoint the earliest event. Then follow the word 'after' in each line.

lines.rookie: A tall man jumps out of the TV van.
lines.junior: A tall man jumps out of the TV van.
lines.master: A tall man leaps out of the TV van.

lines.rookie: Dexter Vance, treasure hunter! I'm here to help!
lines.junior: Dexter Vance, treasure hunter! I've come to help!
lines.master: Dexter Vance, treasure hunter, at your service! I'm here to help!

lines.rookie: Wow! He's on TV every week!
lines.junior: Wow! He's on TV every single week!
lines.master: Wow! He's on television every week!

lines.rookie: The page was taken between nine and ten past ten.
lines.junior: Somebody took the page between nine and ten past ten.
lines.master: The page vanished between nine and ten past ten.

lines.rookie: Then let's go to Grand Central, fast!
lines.junior: Then let's hurry to Grand Central!
lines.master: Then let's make haste to Grand Central!

lines.rookie: How did a TV star hear the news so soon?
lines.junior: How did a TV star get the news so quickly?
lines.master: How could a TV star have learned the news so swiftly?
